summary: 100-foot CCC stairway tower on Gheen Hill, St. Louis County, Minnesota (1934; earlier wood tower 1921); DNR-administered, listed as standing, NHLR-registered 2021.

Communications equipment on the tower as of 2020; several other communications towers on the same hill
Registered January 8, 2021 as US 1486, MN 21; nominated by Jacob Hufnagle

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register gives 1,476 ft (450 m). A 2026 Flickr photo caption gives 1,503 feet. The Register figure is kept as the record elevation; the caption is not authoritative.

notes_for_editor: No source read gives staffing, fire history, or public access for this tower, so no access or staffing key is recorded. The Flickr photo is marked 'All rights reserved', so it is not listed under photos. The Wikidata entry (Q107464014) adds only a name and coordinates and is not cited. The brief's elevation (449.9 m) and build year (1934) agree with the Register.
